The head-to-head history is utterly one-sided: AZ have won all 10 meetings they've won, with SC Cambuur never victorious in 14 tries. The Elo model favors AZ, aligning with both the historical dominance and current form disparity.

While SC Cambuur showed attacking capability in their 3-0 win over NEC Nijmegen, their 1-4-2 record and recent defensive lapses (conceding 4 to FC Twente and 5 to Feyenoord) point to vulnerability. AZ have won their last 1 game and defended the belt 11 times already this reign, demonstrating consistency. The Elo edge and historical dominance make AZ the clear favorite to leave with the belt intact.
